type_2: RTOFS surface vectors versus QC-passing IOOS HF-radar vectors
RTOFS availability over the HF-radar-observed vehicle operating envelope

excluded.waves: NDBC observation is the simulator value.
excluded.water_level: CO-OPS observation is retrieved directly; no harmonic tide model exists.
excluded.wind: ERA5 assimilates observations of this type; cut from deadline scope.

currents.matching_method: Each QC-passing radar cell-hour outside the documented RTOFS land mask is matched to its nearest RTOFS cell/time within explicit tolerances; coarse cells may be reused.
currents.depth_mismatch_disclosure: HF radar effective depth is approximately 2.4 m; the RTOFS proxy is the 0.0 m z level.
currents.statistical_limitation: Matched cell-hours are not independent because many radar cells can map to one coarse RTOFS cell. No independent-sample confidence interval is reported.

depths.disclosure: HF radar effective depth is approximately 2.4 m; the RTOFS proxy is the 0.0 m z level.

temporal_sampling.method: HF-radar fields selected at the 12 embedded RTOFS 3-D nowcast timestamps; no interpolation and no nearest-hour search.
temporal_sampling.limitation: The comparison has one sixth as many model times as the original hourly design; the large cell-hour N does not restore temporal degrees of freedom.

currents.barotropic_velocity_disposition: Excluded from all primary statistics. The diagnostic barotropic field was used only to derive the shared RTOFS wet/land mask.

window_selection.rationale: Maximum predicted tidal range among three-day windows available in the recent RTOFS archive history. CO-OPS hourly predictions give 2.690 m range for this window.
window_selection.statistical_power_limitation: Only 12 RTOFS timestamps are available, one sixth of the 72 timestamps in the original hourly plan.
